history.summary: A $4.25M 4BR penthouse (2153sqft) in Kovan Jewel — a brand-new (2025) 34-unit boutique freehold in D19. The ticket sits far above the liquid band in an OCR location with an extremely shallow buyer pool, and the new-launch-biased URA data overstates appreciation. Wrong product, wrong price band for an investment exit.
history.rating_rationale: Only 34 units total (boutique = illiquid) and a $4.25M penthouse is a tiny, niche exit pool — Hougang/Kovan buyers rarely transact at >$4M. $1,975 PSF looks below the $2,236 median only because penthouse PSF runs low; the absolute quantum is the problem. URA carries a new-launch bias flag (built 2025, 19 txns) so any headline rate is inflated developer pricing, not resale trajectory. Weak score 465 / losing 241-173 record. Freehold + 5-min Kovan MRT (one stop to future Hougang CRL interchange) are the only positives, nowhere near enough to offset a $4.25M boutique OCR penthouse.
red_flags: $4.25M quantum far above OCR/D19 liquid band — very shallow exit pool
New-launch pricing bias (2025 TOP, 19 txns) inflates appreciation signal
catalysts: Kovan MRT (one stop to future Hougang Cross Island Line interchange)
